newsitem.title: USA: Stock buyback news often boosts shr prices - study.
newsitem.headline: Stock buyback news often boosts shr prices - study.

text.p: Stock buyback announcements boost share prices, according to a Standard & Poors study.
The company said in a statement that the study by analyst Paul Cherney was based on the stock price performance of 161 companies announcing buybacks between July 11 and Aug 20.

On average, he found, the shares of these companies outperformed the S&P 500. They posted, on average, a 1.05 percent gain on the day of the buyback announcement, against a 0.29 percent average gain for the S&P 500.

The results are even more dramatic when examined over a longer period. Cherney found that if an investor bought the shares of a company announcing a buyback at the close of trading on the announcement date and held the shares for five trading days, the shares would have gained, on average, 3.21 percent against 1.20 percent for the S&P 500.
If the investor held for 10 trading days, the gain would have been 4.30 percent versus 2.02 percent for the S&P 500.
And the more shares the company intends to repurchase, the better the stock price performance, the study said.
